name: Wish You Were Here
summary: A mooncloth maker in Ashenvale asks you to find Krilge, who vanished while guarding civilians. His comrades call him a deserter, but the maker believes he held his post.

sections.title: A Missing Friend
sections.body: A mooncloth maker met Krilge while making mooncloth in Ashenvale. Krilge was stationed there to protect civilians, then disappeared. They often met at Fallen Sky Lake, until aggressive bog beasts overran it. The maker still hopes to learn what became of him.

sections.title: At the Lake
sections.body: You are asked to search Fallen Sky Lake and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar. Krilge's comrades have stopped looking for him. Perhaps the lake still holds a sign of what became of him.

faq.answer: Krilge was stationed in Ashenvale to protect civilians before he disappeared. He and the mooncloth maker often met at Fallen Sky Lake.

faq.q: Why is Krilge being called a deserter?
faq.answer: Krilge vanished from his post. Those who served with him stopped searching and call him a deserter.

faq.q: Who asks you to look for Krilge?
faq.answer: A mooncloth maker who met Krilge in Ashenvale asks you to search for a sign of him.

faq.q: Where did Krilge and the maker meet?
faq.answer: Krilge and the maker often met at Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale, before aggressive bog beasts overran the area.

faq.q: Where should you report your findings?
faq.answer: You are asked to report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

attribution: In-game quest text: Wish You Were Here
